NOT NECESSARILY THIS SPECIFIC THEORY, BUT THE BOOK AS A WHOLE HAS 
CREATED A PROFOUND IMPRESSION AMONG GERMAN OFFICIALS. CHANCELLOR 
KONRAD ADENAUER HAS ENDORSED THE BOOK AS "ONE OF THE MOST 
POTENT POLITICAL ROUNDUPS TO APPEAR IN GERMANY SINCE THE WAR." 

THE AUTHOR, DRe WILHELM STARLINGER, SAYS RED CHINA'S POPULATION 
SOON WILL BE EXPANDING AT THE RATE OF 20 MILLION A YEAR. BY 
OFFICIAL COMMUNIST FIGURES, THE POPULATION IS NEARLY 600 MILLIONS 

THE ONLY OUTLET FOR HER POPULATION IS NORTHERN ASIA--AND RUSSIA 
WILL FACE THE ALTERNATIVE OF GIVING UP THIS AREA TO CHINA OR 
FIGHTING, STARLINGER WRITES. Jo, 

HE SAYS THE CORNERSTONE OF WEST GERMAN POLICY MUST BE THE’ ” 4 ~ 
CLOSEST POSSIBLE PARTNERSHIP WITH AMERICA. HE ENVISAGES A VAST “J 
"ATLANTIC EMPIRE* HEADED BY THE UNITED STATES, WHOSE SUPERIOR 
POWER WOULD "BRING SOVIET RUSSIA TO REASON AND ENABLE SERIOUS 
NEGOTIATIONS THAT MIGHT LEAD TO A DURABLE UNDERSTANDING." 

"BUT FIRST," HE SAYS, "CHINA MUST BE DETACHED FROM RUSSIA. AND 
RUSSIA'S LEADERSHIP CRISIS MUST ALSO BE TERMINATED BY THE 
EMERGENCE OF A NEW STALIN. UNTIL THEN, IT WOULD BE USELESS TO TALK 
WITH MOSCOW. 

HE WARNS THE UNITED STATES AGAINST BECOMING INVOLVED IN WAR WITH 
EITHER RUSSIA OR CHINA. TO CONQUER EITHER IT WOULD BE NECESSARY TO 
"ERADICATE IT,*® HE SAYS. 

STARLINGER EXPRESSES CONVICTION THAT CHINA CAN BE DETACHED FROM 
RUSSIA IF THE UNITED STATES DROPS CHIANG KAI-SHEK. 

®THE KUOMINTANG CAN NEVER BE RESTORED TO POWER, HE SAYS. 

HE PREDICTS RUSSIA WILL FIGHT CHINA TO RETAIN THE RICHES OF ITS 
EASTERN PROVINCES. 

"AND WHEN THAT STRUGGLE BEGINS, SOVIET RUSSIA MAY STAND ON THE 
WESTERN SIDE OF THE BARRICADE" WITH THE UNITED STATES IN A LIFE-AND- 
DEATH STRUGGLE, HE ASSERTS. 

STARLINGER HEADED A HOSPITAL IN KOENIGSBERG_IN EAST PRUSSIA IN 1945,

LAID DO = AY TO BRING EVENTUAL HOME RULE AND 
POSSIBLE PEACE TO THE TROUBLED NORTH AFRICAN PROTECTORATE. 

THE AGREEMENT IN PRINCIPLE, REACHED AFTER MIDNIGHT BY FRENCH PREMIER 
EDGAR FAURE AND TUNISIAN PREMLER TAHAR BEN AMMAR, MUST STILL BE WORKED 
OUT IN DETAIL BEFORE A FINAL TEXT IS DRAWN UP. 

THEN IT MUST BE APPROVED BY THE AGED BEY OF TUNIS -- TUNISIA’S 
NOMINAL RULER -- AND THE BALKY FRENCH ASSEMBLY. 

THE BEY'S APPROVAL IS CONSIDERED CERTAIN. BUT IN THE ASSEMBLY THE 
AGREEMENT IS CERTAIN TO ENCOUNTER OPPOSITION FROM MEMBERS SYMPATHETIC 
TO THE FRENCH COLONISTS WHO CONSTITUTE A POWERFUL MINORITY IN TUNISIA. 

THE ACCORD ALSO IS EXPECTED TO RUN UP AGAINST A STRONG UNDERCURRENT 
OF FRENCH NATIONAL PRIDE, LOATH TO YIELD STILL MORE OF FRANCE'S 
PREWAR GLORY OF EMPIRE. 

ENDING SEVEN MONTHS OF FITFUL NEGOTIATIONS, THE AGREEMENT CAME 
JUST BEFORE THE AGREED DEADLINE--THE MONTH-LONG HOLY SEASON OF 
RAMADAN WHEN THE MOSLEM FAITHFUL SUSPEND MOST BUSINESS. 

TUNISIAN SOURCES SAID THE AGREEMENT HAD CLEARED. ONE IMPORTANT

~“THORSHAVN, FAERO INDS, APRIL 22 (AP)-REVOLUTIONARY SPIRIT FLARED 
HIGH ON BORDO ISLAND TONIGHT AS DEFIAN (NDERS BRACED FOR 
BATTLE AGAINST A DANISH POLICE EXPEDITIONARY FORCE. 

HARPOONS, BOATHOOKS AND SHOTGUNS WERE MOBILIZED TO REPEL 120 
TOUGH COPENHAGEN RIOT POLICE ORDERED TO LAND MONDAY AND REMOVE THE 
ISLAND DOCTOR. 

RADIO ORDERS WENT OUT TO ALL TRAWLERS AND CUTTERS OWNED BY BORDO 
FISHING COMPANIES TO RETURN TO THEIR HOME PORT, KLAKSVIG, CHIEF TOWN 
OF THE DANISH ISLAND SITUATED IN THE NORTH ATLANTIC BETWEEN ICELAND 
AND THE SHETLANDS. 

THE SMALL VESSELS PROBABLY WILL BE ANCHORED BOW-TO-STERN TO 
BLOCK THE HARBOR ENTRANCE IN AN EFFORT TO PREVENT THE SHIP CARRYING 
THE POLICE DETACHMENT FROM DOCKING. 

THE KLAKSVIGERS CELEBRATED TODAY WITH SINGING AND DANCING IN THE 
STREETS THEIR VICTORY YESTERDAY OVER GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS WHO WANTED 
TO REMOVE DR. E.sHALVORSEN AS DISTRICT DOCTOR, A POST HE HAS HELD 
UNLAWFULLY FOR TWO YEARS. 

ALL THOSE AMONG THE 2,600 ISLANDERS WHO OPPOSED THE ORGANIZED 
RESISTANCE WERE PUSHED AND JEERED. BORDO'S TWO POLICEMEN LOCKED 
THEMSELVES IN THEIR HOMES FOR FEAR OF BEING BEATEN. ONE POLICEMAN 
SUFFERED A BEATING YESTERDAY. 

THE SHIP CARRYING THE RIOT POLICE ARMED WITH PISTOLS AND TEARGAS 
IS SCHEDULED TO ARRIVE AT THORSHAVN, 15 MILES FROM KLAKSVIG, SOMETIME 
SUNDAY. THE ACTION AGAINST BORDO WILL TAKE PLACE MONDAY MORNING, 
ACCORDING TO PRESENT PLANS. 

DANISH OFFICIALS SAID THEY HOPED THE ISLANDERS--MAINLY FISHERMEN 
AND SHEEPHERDERS--WILL COOL OFF WHEN THEY SEE THE SHOW OF FORCE. But 
REPORTS OVER THE SHAKY KLAKSVIG TELEPHONE CONNECTION SAY THE 
AROUSED PEOPLE ARE PREPARING FOR A TERRIFIC FIGHT. 

THERE IS AT LEAST ONE DANISH NAVY VESSEL IN FAEROE WATERS--THE 
FRIGATE NIELS EBBESEN, AT PRESENT WATCHING THE MOVEMENTS OF A LARGE 
RUSSIAN FISHING FLEET. GOVERNMENT SOURCES SAID IT WOULD TAKE NO PART 


IN THE ACTION.

AT BORDO DIED AND HALVORSEN WAS ASSIGNED TO THE POST UNTIL ANOTHER 
DOCTOR COULD BE APPOINTED. WHEN THE NEW DOCTOR WAS NAMED 
HALVORSEN REFUSED TO LEAVE AND THE ISLANDERS BACKED HIS STAND. 
MEANWHILE, AN OFFICIAL INVESTIGATION OF HALVORSEN'S AFFILIATION 
WITH THE NAZi PARTY WAS MADE AT THE DOCTOR'S OWN REQUEST. HE WAS

WE, THE DELEGATES OF THE ASIAN-AFRICAN CONFERENCE: BEING 
PAINFULLY AWARE OF THE CALAMITIES CAUSED BY TWO WORLD WARS AND 
THE DANGERS ATTENDING INTERNATIONAL TENSION THAT_HAS PREVAILED SINCE; 
AND ALSO FEARFUL OF THE DIRE PROBABILITY THAT A THIRD WORLD WAR 
JILL PROVOKE USE OF ATOMIC WEAPONS INEVITABLY ENTAILING ANNIHILIBATION 
OF MANKIND, AND 
BEING ANXIOUS TO EASE INTERNATIONAL TENSION AND PREVENT WAR 
BY SEIZING EVERY OPPORTUNITY AND ALL AVAILABLE MEANS; AND TO 
PROMOTE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND ADVANCE SOCIAL WELFARE OF THE 
REGION AND THEREBY CONTRIBUTE TO THE MAINTENANCE OF WORLD PEACE, BASED 
ON THE PRINCIPLE OF wi Te ee AND SECURITY, 


DO SOLEMNLY DECLARES AS FOLLOWS: 
1. IN CONFORMITY WITH THE SPIRIT AND PURPOSES OF THE UNITED NATIONS 


CHARTER, ALL ASIAN COUNTRIES SHOULD DESIST FROM RESORTING TO FORCE 
OR THE THREAT OF FORCE ATANY STAGE OR IN ANY KIND OF ANY SITUATION 
LIABLE TO LEAD TO WAR, BUT SEEK ITS SOLUTION THROUGH PEACEFUL 


MEANS, 
RECOGNIZING THE FACT THAT ELEVATION OF LIVING STANDARDS 
VITAL FACTOR FOR PEACE AND STABILITY, THE COUNTRIES OF THE ASTAH” ” 
AFRICAN REGION SHALL PROMOTE COOPERATION AMONG THEMELVES IN THE 
PROSPERITY OF ALL. —

EFT WING ORGANIZATION TRYING TO “CAPTURE THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY.*

THE REPUBLICANS ARE MERELY OFFERING “ANOTHER EXAMPLE 
OF THE HEALTHY STATE OF THEIR POCKETBOOK AND THE POOR STATE OF THEIR 
POLITICS.

THE DOCUMENT COMPILED BY ITS STAFF. |

SUCH AS THEY ARE WILLING TO ENDORSE AND MAKE THEIR OWN.®

oe NeYs, APRIL 22 (AP)-SYRIA PROTESTED TO THE UNITED 
WATE ARE TO DRY RORENT STS PRONRE SSN SREELT 7 ATION™ OF ABODT 350 ARAB 
VILLAGERS IN A DEMILITARIZED ZONE OF THE SYRIAN-ISRAELI FRONTIER, 

SYRIA SAID THE VILLAGERS OF BAQQARA WERE WOOED BY ISRAEL WITH "EDu- 
CATION AND MEDICAL CARE LAVISHED ON THEM WITH MALICIOUS INTENT." 

THE PRTEST WAS INCLUDED IN A LETTER FROM THE SYRIAN FOREIGN MINISTRY 
TO MAJe GEN. EeL.M. BURNS, U.N. PALESTINE TRUCE CHIEF, COMMENTING ON 
HIS JANUARY REPORT ON FRONTIER CONDITIONS. 

THE RESIDENTS OF BAQQARA FLED FROM THEIR HOMES TO SYRIA DURING THE 
1948 PALESTINIAN WAR BUT WERE ALLOWED TO RETURN THERE UNDER TERMS OF A 
1951 SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION. 

NOW, SAID SYRIA'S LETTER, SYRIA CANNOT TAKE THEM BACK AGAIN AS REFU- 
CEES BECAUSE SYRIA ALREADY fiAS TWOO MANY ARAB REFUGEES FROM ISRAEL. 

THE CAREFULLY WORDED LETTER, HOWEVER, INDICATED THAT SYRIA MIGHT, 
UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES, CONSIDER DIVIDING THE MILITARIZED ZONES 


WITH ISRAEL. 
BURNS HAD PROPOSED SUCH PARTITION AS A MEANS OF ELIMINATING TROUBLE 


SPOTS~ | 
WHEN THE PALESTINE WAR ENDED, SYRIAN TROOPS HELD THE DISPUTED TERRI- 
TORIES ON THE ISRAELI SIDE OF THE FRONTIER. ISRAEL WANTED THESE FORCES 
WITHDRAWN, BUT SYRIA REFUSED. A COMPROMISE WAS REACHED BY DEMILI- 
TARIZING THEM. , 
BURNS HAD SAID THAT THE BAQQARA PEOPLE WERE LIVING UNDER BAD CONDI-

APRIL 24 (AP)-FOLLOWING IS A RESOLUTION ON 
MASS DESTRUCTION AND DIS 


ARMAMENT ADOPTED TODAY BY THE ASIAN-AFRICAN 
CONFERENCE: (ABOUT 300) 


THE ASIAN-AFRICAN CONFERENCE, HAVING CONSIDERED THE DANGEROUS 
SITUATION OF INTERNATIONAL TENSION EXISTING AND THE RISKS CONFRONTING 
THE WHOLE HUMAN RACE FROM THE OUTBREAK OF GLOBAL WAR IN WHICH THE 
DESTRUCTIVE POWER OF ALL TYPES OF ARMAMENTS, INCLUDING NUCLEAR AND 
THERMONUCLEAR WEAPONS, WOULD BE EMPLOYED INVITES THE ATTENTION OF ALL 
NATIONS TO THE TERRIBLE CONSEQUENCES THAT FOLLOW IF SUCH A WAR WERE 


TO BREAK OUT. 
THE CONFERENCE CONSIDERS THAT DISARMAMENT AND THE PROHIBITION OF THE 


TION, EXPERIMENTATION AND USE OF NUCLEAR AND THERMONUCLEAK 
WEAPONS OF WAR ARE IMPERATIVE TO SAVE MANKIND AND CIVILIZATION FRom 
THE FEAR AND PROSPECT OF WHOLESALE DESTRUCTION. IT CONSIDERS THAT THE 
NATIONS OF ASIA AND AFRICA ASSEMBLED HERE HAVE A DUTY TOWARD 
HUMANITY AND CIVILIZATION TO PROCLAIM THEIR SUPPORT FOR THE PROHIBITION, 

THE CONFERENCE CONSIDERS THAT EFFECTIVE INTERNATIONAL CONTROL 

SHOULD BE ESTABLISHED AND MAINTAINED TO IMPLEMENT SUCH PROHIBITION, AND 
SPEEDY AND 


DETERMINED EFFORTS SHOULD BE MADE TO THIS END. 
PENDING TOTAL PROHIBITION OF THE MANUFACTURE OF NUCLEAR AND THERMO- 


NUCLEAR WEAPONS, THIS CONFERENCE APPEALS TO ALL POWERS CONCERNED TO 
REACH AGREEMENT TO SUSPEND EXPERIMENTS WITH SUCH WEAPONS. 

THE CONFERENCE DECLARES THAT UNIVERSAL DISARMAMENT IS AN ABSOLUTE 
NECESSITY FOR THE PRESERVATION OF PEACE, AND REQUESTS THE UNITED 
NATIONS TO CONTINUE ITS EFFORTS, AND APPEALS TO ALL CONCERNED SPEEDILY 
TO BRING ABOUT THE REGULATION LIMITATION rant 3g BI AND REDUCTION OF ALL 
ARMED FORCES AND ARMAMENTS INCLUDING THE PROHIBITION OF PRODUCTION, 
EXPERIMENTATIONS AND USE OF ALL WEAPONS OF MASS DESTRUCTION, AND TO 
ESTABLISH EFFECTIVE INTERNATIONAL CONTROL TO THIS END. CEND TEXT)

VANCE)  WhaSHINGTON, APRIL 24 (AP)-THE ATOMIC 
TONIGHT ASKED PRIVATE INDUSTRY To FINANCE AND BUILD BY EARLY 1957 
B BUCLEAR REACTOR CAPABLE OF TESTING LARGER MATERIALS THAN IS NOW 

THE AEC DOESN'T WANT A BIGGER REACTOR. WHAT IT NEED 
BIGGER HOLES IN ITS SIDES=-THROUGH WHICH SCIENTISTS CAN SHOVE se 
MATERIALS» BOMBARD THEM WITH INTENSE RADIATION AND STUDY THE EFFECTS. 

THE LARGEST IRRADIATION SPACE NOW AVAILABLE, THE AEC SAID, IS 
ONE HOLE ABOUT 5 INCHES SQUARE AT THE MATERIALS TESTING REACTOR AT 
IDAHO FALLS, IDAHO. THE AEC SUGGESTED CONSTRUCTION OF A REACTOR WITH 
{i HOLES RANGING FROM 3 INCHES SQUARE TO 9 INCHES SQUARE. 

THE AEC SAID THE REACTOR'S CORE DESIGN SHOULD BE FLEXIBLE 
ENOUGH TO MAKE POSSIBLE THE INSERTION OF SPECIMENS AS LARGE AS 15 
INCHES IN DIAMETER. 

THE ANNOUNCEMENT INDICATED THE PLANT WOULD BE USED TO DETERMINE 
WHAT MATERIALS WILL BE NEEDED AND HOW THEY CAN BE USED TO BUILD 
REACTORS THAT WILL WITHSTAND THE TERRIFIC AND CONTINUOUS ONSLAUGHT OF 
RADIATION IN POWER INSTALLATIONS OF THE FUTURE. 

THE AEC CALLS IT “AN ENGINEERING TEST REACTOR" FOR THE DEVELOPMENT 
OF “CORES, FUEL ASSEMBLIES AND OTHER COMPONENTS OF REACTOR PROJECTS 
OF THE AIR FORCE, NAVY, ARMY AND CIVILIAN NUCLEAR POWER PROGRAM." 

PRESUMABLY THIS MEANS THE REACTOR WILL PLAY A ROLE IN THE DEVELOP- 
MENT OF NUCLEAR PLANTS FOR CIVILIAN USES AND FOR SUCH MILITARY NEEDS 
AS ATOMIC SUBMARINES, SURFACE VESSELS, PLANES AND TANKSe 

THE AEC SAID IT WOULD CONTRACT WITH THE OWNER AND OPERATOR OF THE 
REACTOR FOR USE OF "A SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT® OF ITS IRRADIATION CAPACITY 
FOR THE FIRST FIVE YEARS OF ITS OPERATION. 

THE COMMISSION SET UP A TIGHT TIME SCHEDULE FOR COMPLETION OF THE 
JOB IN ITS INVITATION FOR PROPOSALS. IT SAID BIDS MUST BE SUBMITTED 
By JULY 1, CONSTRUCTION MUST START BY OCTOBER AND THE PROJECT MUST BE 
IN OPERATION BY MARCH, 1957. THE AEC HAS THE FINAL SAY ON WHO CAN BE 
LICENSED. 

THE ANNOUNCEMENT ALSO SUGGESTED THAT THE PLANT BE CONSTRUCTED 
NEAR THE GOVERNMENT'S NATIONAL REACTOR TESTING STATION IN IDAHO. 

ITS REACTOR HELPED DEVELOP THE POWER PLANT FOR TKE COUNTRY'S FIRST 
ATOMIC SUBMARINE, THE NAUTILUS, 

THE AEC SAID iT WOULD CONSIDER LEASING SPACE AT THE IDAHO INSTALLA- 
TIONe IT ESTIMATED THAT BY USING EXISTING SERVICES THERE, PRIVATE 
INDUSTRY COULD BUILD THE REACTOR FOR BETWEEN 10 AND 15 MILLION DOLLARS. 

THE COMMISSION ESTIMATED THE ANNUAL COST OF OPERATIONS, EXCLUDING 
THAT OF EXPERIMENTS. OULD RUN BETWEEN FOUR AND FIVE MILLION DOLLARS. 
THIS WOULD INCLUDE FUEL FABRICATION, FUEL BURNED, RECOVERY OF 
UNBURNED URANIUM-235, DEPRECIATION ON A 20-YEAR BASIS AND AN ALLOw- 
ANCE OF 15 PER CENT FOR GENERAL OVERHEAD.

(ADVANCE) &lt;TUCSON, ARIZe, APRIL 24 (AP)-THE MYSTERY OF HOW CAMELS 
WORK FOR A WEEK IN BLAZING DESERT HEAT WITHOUT DRINKING HAS BEEN 
SOLVED. 

ANCIENT LORE SAID THE CAMEL'S HUMP WAS FILLED WITH WATER. 
WRONG. THE HUMP IS SOLID FAT. 

MODERN LORE SAID THE CAMEL DRANK GREAT QUANTITIES OF WATER AND 
STORED IT IN ONE OF HIS MULTIPLE STOMACHES. WRONG AGAIN. 

THE CAMEL'S UNIGUE ABILITY TURNS OUT TO BE THE RESULT OF HALF A 
DOZENUEXTRAORDINARY GIFTS NOT SHARED BY ANY OTHER ANIMAL. 

DRe KNUT SCHMLDISNIELSEN OF DUKE UNIVERSITY DIRECTED A YEAR'S STUDY 
TO DETERMINE HOW THE SHIPS OF THE DESERT SURVIVED. THE WORK WAS 
DONE AT BENI ABBES, 500 MILES WITHIN THE ALGERIAN SAHARA. THERE THE 
TEMPERATURE OFTEN REACHES 140 DEGREES. 

DRe SCHMIDT-NIELSEN REPORTED HIS FINDINGS TODAY TO THE UNITED 
NATIONS EDUCATIONAL, SCIENTIFIC AND CULTURAL ORGANIZATION'S COMMITTEE 
ON ARID ZONE RESEARCH. THE GROUP COMPLETED A TWO-DAY MEETING HERE

GENERALS, ADMIRALS AND °SCIENTIFIC REPRESENTATIVES® FROM MOST OF 
THE WESTERN WORLD HAVE BEEN QUIETLY ARRIVING IN PARIS FOR STRATEGIC 
TALKS WHICH WOULD HOLD THE FATE OF EUROPE SHOULD WAR BREAK OUT. 

THE STRATEGY AND TACTICS ARE SECRET BUT THE IDEA OF ATOMIC 
WARFARE IS PLAIN. AMONG THE PARTICIPANTS IS GEN. CURTIS LEMAY, WHO 
HEADS THE UsSe STRATEGIC AIR COMMAND. HIS FORCE HAS THE PUNCH TO 
DELIVER NUCLEAR WEAPONS ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD. 

OFFICIALLY THE GAMES ARE KNOWN AS “COMMAND POST EXERCISE 
PIVE® AND ARE UNDER THE DIRECTION OF FIELD MARSHAL VISCOUNT MONTGOMERY 
DEPUTY SUPREME ALLIED COMMANDER EUROPE. 

HIS ®STUDENTS® INCLUDE SOME 230 GOLD BRAIDED OFFICERS ASSEMBLED 
FROM NORTH AMERICA AND THE LONG NORTH ATLANTIC TREATY FRONTIER 
EXTENDING FROM THE NORTHERN TIP OF NORWAY TO THE EASTERN BORDER OF 


TURTHE EXERCISE--TO CONTINUE FOR FIVE BAYS--INVOLVES NO ACTUAL TROOP 
MOVEMENTSe THE COMMANDERS SIMPLY GET TOGETHER IN VARYING GROUPS 
TO THRASH OUT WHAT WOULD See sart SAY, IF MASSED SOVIET DIVISIONS 


AND A FLEET OF WARPLANES SMASHED AGAINST THE NATO FRONTIER 
ANYWHERE ALONG THE LINE.

MAY 1e THE FORCES ARE WAGING A CAMPAIGN AGAINST BLACK MARKETING, 

CIGARETTE ALLOTMENTS WILL BE REDUCED FROM 15 TO 10 PACKAGES WEEKLY 
IN GERMANY AND FRANCE. THE LIMIT OF 10 HAS BEEN IN EFFECT 
IN BRITAIN FOR TWO YEARS. PERSONS WHO CERTIFY THEY SMOKE MORE CAN 
GET AS MUCH AS FIVE PACKS ADDITIONAL PER WEEKe 

THE PRESENT ONE-POUND MONTHLY COFFEE RATION FOR PERSONNEL LIVING 71 
BARRACKS WILL BE ELIMINATED. MILITARY PERSONNEL LIVING IN THEIR own 
QUARTERS CAN STILL GET FOUR POUNDS A MONTH. | 

BOTH COFFEE AND CIGARETTES ARE SOLD TO SERVICE PERSONNEL IN Post 
EXCHANGES AND COMMISSARIES. THE ARMY SAID SURVEYS SHOWED PRESENT 
RATIONS EXCEED ACTUAL NEEDS. 

A NUMBER OF AMERICAN ARMY WIVES HAVE BEEN CAUGHT IN THE CAMPAIc) 
AGAINST BLACK MARKETING. MILITARY COURTS FINED SOME OF THEM FoR 
BARTERING POST EXCHANGE COFFEE AND CIGARETTES. 

GERMAN CUSTOMS AUTHORITIES TODAY ANNOUNCED THE SMASHING OF A 
LARGESCALE CIGARETTE SMUGGLING RING AT ULM. THEY SAID CHARGES WERE 

-BEING PREPARED AGAINST THE RING LEADERS. THE CUSTOMS AGENTS SAID 
THAT 5,000 CARTONS OF AMERICAN CIGARETTES HAD BEEN ILLEGALLY SOLD AT 
A BIG FIRM AT ULM IN THE PAST YEAR.

MISSION OF WALTER 5. ROBERTSON AND ADM. ARTHUR We RADFORD TO FORMOSA

OF STATE NOR THE CHAIRMAN OF THE JOINT CHIEFS OF STAFF SUGGESTED 
WITHDRAWAL FROM THE OFFSHORE ISLANDS OF QUEMOY AND THE MATSUS. 
BEFORE LEAVING FOR WASHINGTON TODAY WITH RADFORD, ROBERTSON TOLD 
NEWSMEN TALKS WITH PRESIDENT CHIANG KAI-SHEK WERE CONCERNED WITH 
THE MUTUAL DEFENSE TREATY, THE UNITED STATES GUARDS FORMOSA AND THE 
ADJACENT PESCADORES FROM CHINESE COMMUNIST ATTACKS. 
ROBERTSON DECLINED TO COMMENT ON THE OFFSHORE ISLAND QUESTION.

IN THIS SECOND IN A SERIES OF ARTICLES SURVEYING THE COLD WAR AREA 


FROM FRANCE TO TURKEY.) 
BY WILLIAM Le RYAN 
AP FOREIGN NEWS ANALYST 

(ADVANCE) «sPARIS, APRIL 27 (AP)-COMMUNISM IN WESTERN EUROPE IS IN A 
TRAP OF SOVIET DESIGN.

THE BELLWETHER FRENCH COMMUNIST PARTY, IN AN ORDER WHICH 

COMMUNISTS MUST NOT DIVORCE ECONOMIC 
QUESTIONS. THUS, CAMPAIGNS FOR HIGHER WAGES, FOR EXAMPLE, MUST BE

BUT IN THE INTERESTS OF LONG-RANGE SOVIET OBJECTIVES, THE COMMUNISTS

HERE ARE SOME OF THE RESULTS? 
IN ITALY: COMMUNISTS WERE ROUTED IN SHOP ELECTIONS OF THE FIAT WORKS 


IN TURIN, THE COUNTRY'S “LITTLE DETROIT.” THE REDS LOST HEAVILY 
IN OTHER INDUSTRIAL ELECTIONS, INCLUDING MILAN AND OTHER AREAS OF 
THE “RED NORTH.” AMONG THE FARMERS THE CHRISTIAN DEMOCRATIC PARTY 
HAS BEEN SHOWING NEW STRENGTH. THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY THE CISL 
(CHRISTIAN DEMOCRATIC LABOR FEDERATION) HAS UNDERTAKEN A _ VIGOROUS 
ANTI-COMMUNIST OFFENSIVE. IT CAPITALIZES ON THE PARALYSIS OF 
ACTION THAT THE LEADERSHIP OF THE CGIL (COMMUNIST-DOMINATED LABOR 
FEDERATION) INHERITS FROM THE NEED TO TOE THE LINE. 

ONCE THE CGIL CLAIMED 5 MILLION MEMBERSe ITS MEMBERSHIP TODAY IS 
ABOUT 3 MILLION, OF WHOM AT LEAST 30 PER CENT PAY NO DUES. THE 
ANTI-COMMUNIST UNIONS ARE EDGING TOWARD THE 2-MILLION MEMBERSHIP 


MARK e 
IN FRANCE: THE COMMUNIST-RUN GENERAL LABOR CONFEDERATION (CGT) 


CLAIMED 6 MILLION MEMBERS AT ITS PEAK IN 19466 A YEAR LATER WHEN THE 
ANTI-COMMUNIST WORKERS* FORCE WAS FORMED, THE CGT STILL CLAIMED 4 
MILLION. TODAY THE ESTIMATE OF CGT STRENGTH HAS DROPPED TO 2 1/2 
MILLION. THE FRENCH COMMUNIST PARTY HAD 850,000 MEMBERS AT ITS 

PEAK IN 1946. IT NOW HAS ABOUT 300,000. THE CIRCULATION OF L*HUMANITE, 
THE COMMUNIST MORNING NEWSPAPER, HAS DWINDLED FROM 600,000 TO 

125,000. THE COMMUNIST EVENING PAPER, CE SOIR, ONCE BOASTING A HALF 
MILLION CIRCULATION, WENT OUT OF BUSINESS FROM LACK OF READERS. 

THE SITUATION HAS BROUGHT GRUMBLING AMONG PARTY LEADERS. THE 
“TOGLIATTI LINE,” PROPOUNDED BY RED BOSS PALMIRO TOGLIATTI IN ITALY, 
MADE TOUGH MILITANTSSQUIRM. SUCH A MILITANT IS PIETRO SECCHIA, 

DEPUTY SECRETARY GENERAL, WHO COMPOSED LEAFLETS FOR THE RECENT 
PARTY CONGRESS. THESE CRITICIZED THE PARTY LEADERSHIP AS BECOMING 
“SOFT AND BOURGEOIS. ® 

ITALIAN ANTI-COMMUNISTS, QUICK TO NOTE THE RED EMBARRASSMENT, HAVE 
PLASTERED THE CITIES WITH POSTERS RIDICULING THEIR OBVIOUS SUBSERVIENCE 
TO MOSCOW. ONE POSTER WHOWS TOGLIATTI IN AN IMPASSIONED ORATORICAL 
GESTURE, WITH THE CAPTIONS *I ALWAYS WAS FOR BULGANIN.® IT WAS A 
REFERENCE TO THE DOWNFALL OF GEORGI MALENKOV AND THE APPOINTMENT OF 
NIKOLAI BULGANIN AS SOVIET PREMIER. 

FRENCH ANTI-COMMUNISTS WATCH WITH SATISFACTION A DEBATE RAGING 
AMONG THE REDS AS THE PARTY PREPARES FOR A JUNE CONGRESS OF THE 
CGT. THE DEBATE IS OVER THE “PROGRAM OF ACTION.* ONE RED LEADER 
HAS BEEN COMPLAINING BITTERLY THAT THE PROSPECTIVE PROGRAM PLAYS INTO 
THE HANDS OF THE PARTY'S "WORST ENEMIES." BUT THE DISSIDENTS WILL LOSE. 

THE SYMPTOMS OF THIS DISEASE ARE NOTICEABLE AMONG COMMUNIST 
PARTIES OF ALL WESTERN EUROPE. THEY ARE BALKED IN THEIR DRIVE 


FOR MASS SUPPORT BY THE OVERRIDING SOVIET INTEREST IN DIVIDING 
WRENCH INTO WESTERN DEFENSE 


ALL THIS WOULD SEEM TO ADD UP TO A HAPPY AUGURY FOR THE WEST. 
FIGURES DO NOT TELL THE WHOLE STORY. THE HARD REALITY IS THAT THE 


BUT 








ee eee — 


COMMUNIST PARTIES ARE NOT PRIMARILY INTERESTED IN NUMBERS. THE 
FACT IS THAT THE COMMUNISTS IN BOTH ITALY AND FRANCE REMAIN A POTENT 

AND DANGEROUS FORCE, AND WILL BE SO LONG AS THEY HAVE THEIR SMALL, 

HARD CORES OF DISCIPLINED MILITANTS READY TO OBEY MOSCOW. 

ACHIEVEMENT OF THE MAIN SOVIET GOALS, NEUTRALISM IN EUROPE AND 
DIVISION OF THE WESTERN ALLIES, NEEDS POWERFUL SUPPORT. THAT ACCOUNTS 
FOR THE STRANGE SPECTACLE OF THE PARTY OPENLY WOOING THE UPPER 
MIDDLE CLASSES, MAKING PERSUASIVE GESTURES IN THE DIRECTION OF 
BUSINESSMEN, SPEAKING SOFTLY OF THE NEED FOR UNITY OF ALL PARTS OF THE 

FRITTERING AWAY COMMUNIST SUPPORT AMONG THE WORKING 
CLASSES. CALCULATED RISK IS INVOLVED. 

AT THE SAME TIME, THE COMMUNISTS SEEM VISIBLY CONCERNED AT THE LOSS 
OF SUPPORT AMONG THE WORKERS. ONE OF THE AGENCIES MOST CONCERNED 
WITH ATTEMPTING TO STEM THE TIDE IS THE WORLD FEDERATION OF TRADE UNIONS 
(WFTU). ITS LEADERSHIP REPRESENTS THE MOST IMPORTANT BRANCH OF 
TODAY'S MANY-BRANCHED COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL. 

EARLY IN MARCH, A PROCESSION OF RED BIG SHOTS FROM NON-COMMUNIST 
COUNTRIES SLIPPED INTO VIENNA FOR A MEETING WITH THE SOVIET BRAINS 
OF THE WFTU. THESE LEADERS INCLUDED SUCH IMPORTANT FIGURES AS LUIGI 
LONGO AND GIUSEPPE DI VITTORIO OF ITALY, LAURENT CASANOVA, ALAIN LE 
LEAP AND LOUIS SAILLANT OF FRANCE, AND LABOR LEADERS FROM MANY OTHER 
COUNTRIES. BEFORE THEY LEFT THEY APPARENTLY DECIDED ON THE NEXT 
TWIST IN TACTICS, WITH THESE EXPECTED ASPECTS: 

ie A SPECTACULAR ATTEMPT TO JOIN FORCES WITH THE FREE TRADE UNIONS 
UNDER WHAT WILL LOOK LIKE ATTRACTIVE TERMS, FOR A COMMON FRONT 
KEYED TO “PEACE® AND WORKERS’ RIGHTS. 

2. A DRIVE AGAINST WESTERN REARMAMENT AT FACTORY LEVELS. WHILE 
WOOING LEADERS OF FREE UNIONS, THE COMMUNISTS AT THE SAME TIME WILL 
URGE WORKERS AT FACTORY LEVELS TO TURN THEIR BACKS ON THEIR LEADERS 
AND TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS IF THEY WANT TO AVOID BEING 
DRAGGED INTO A NEW WARs 

3, EXTENDING TO LOCAL COMMUNIST PARTIES A MUCH LARGER DEGREE OF 
DISCRETION IN DAY-TO-DAY DEALINGS WITH TRADE UNIONS THEY CONTROL 
SQ ACTIONS CAN BETTER FIT PATTERNS OF PARTICULAR NATIONAL CONDITIONS. 
THIS MEANS MORE INDEPENDENCE OF ACTION WITHOUT PREVIOUS REFERENCE BACK 
TO THE CENTER--TO MOSCOW THROUGH THE WFTU COUNCIL. 

THERE IS A HINT OF SOVIET DESPERATION IN THIS, AN IDEA THAT THE NEXT 
FEW YEARS IN EUROPE WILL BE HIGHLY CRITICAL. THE MAIN SOVIET AIM IS TO 
PREVENT WEST GERMAN ARMAMENT, AT WHATEVER COST. 

THERE IS EVEN A HINT THAT MOSCOW CONSIDERS ITSELF UP AGAINST 
SUCH A FIERCE POLITICAL BATTLE IN EUROPE THAT AN EVENTUAL CRISIS 
MIGHT LEAD IN SOME AREAS TO OUTLAWING THE COMMUNIST PARTY. IF THAT 
WERE TO HAPPEN, THE WAY WOULD HAVE TO BE CLEAR FOR THE PARTY TO GO 
UNDERGROUND. THIS WOULD REQUIRE LOCAL FREEDOM TO MAKE INDEPENDENT 
DECISIONSe IF THIS IS WHAT THE RUSSIANS ARE CONTEMPLATING, THE 
IMPLICATION IS THAT MOSCOW FEARS ITSELF MOVING TOWARD DANGEROUS 6

MINISTERS OF THE COMMONWEALTH WERE UNITED IN THEIR CONVICTION,® HE 
WROTE, "THAT THE POSSESSION OF THE BOMB BY THE ALLIES WAS AT THE MOMENT 
THE BEST DETERRENT TO AGGRESSION AND THAT THIS WOULD GIVE A BREATHING 
SPACE IN WHICH PEACE-MAKING COULD BE VIGOROUSLY PURSUED. 

“I SUPPORT THIS POLICY NOT BECAUSE I THINK IT IS IDEAL, 

BUT BECAUSE I BELIEVE THAT THE POSSESSION OF THE BOMB BY A 
PEACE-LOVING STATE LIKE OUR OWN GIVES SOME HOPE (I DO NOT 
PUT IT HIGHER THAN THAT) THAT THE BOMB MAY NEVER BE USED 
AGAINST OUR NATION, OR AGAINST RUSSIA OR CHINA OR ANY OTHER 

"MANY OF MY CORRESPONDENTS DWELL ON THE WICKEDNESS OF USING 
THE BOMB AGAINST RUSSIA, BUT THEY DO NOT SEEM TO HAVE REALIZED 
THAT IT IS MUCH MORE PROBABLE THAT IT MAY BE USED AGAINST US."

abio’ 13 PER CENT OF PEASANT HOUSEHOLDS IN CHINA, SAYS PEIPING 

. 

AND THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY HAD TOLD

RURAL ECONOMY.® 

TU JUN-SHENG, SECRETARY GENERAL OF THE COMMITTEE'S RURAL WORK 
DEPARTMENT, REPORTS IN THE SEMIMONTHLY PUBLICATION PEOPLE'S CHINA 
THAT NEARLY 600 000 COOPERATIVES HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED. 

TU SAYS *POOR PEASANTS" AND *MIDDLE PEASANTS,* THE LANDLESS oF 
OTHER DAYS, ARE “THE DRIVING FORCE IN THE SOCIALIST REVOLUTION IN THE 
COUNTRYSIDE.® THEY MAKE UP 70 PER CENT OF THE PEASANTS. 

THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OUT OF RED CHINA, HOWEVER, THAT THIS 
“DRIVING FORCE® IS NOT UNANIMOUSLY ENAMORED OF STATE OWNERSHIP. 

GIVEN LAND AFTER LIQUIDATION OF LANDLORDS AND “RICH PEASANTS,® THEY 
WERE UNWILLING TO GIVE IT UP TO THE COLLECTIVE IDEAL. 

THE FIRST STEP TOWARD STATE CONTROL IS MUTUAL AID TEAMS. TOOLS, 
FARM ANIMALS AND LABOR ARE POOLED TO SOW AND REAP ON FARMS iN A 
COMMUNITY. MEMBERS GET A PROPORTIONAL oe OF NET INCOME. THEY 
TECHNICALLY STILL OWN LAND EMBRACED BY THE COOPERATIVE. BUT IT 
WOULD TAKE ONLY A DECREE OUT OF PEIPING TO TURN A COOPERATIVE FARM 
INTO A COLLECTIVE FARM, WHERE PEASANTS BECOME NOTHING MORE THAN 
LABORERS FOR THE STATE.

i. THE RETREAT OF COMMUNIST PARTIES IN EUROPE BEHIND A “SOFT 
LINE® DENOTES SOVIET WORRY OVER THE POSSIBILITY THAT MOSCOW MAY STUMBLE 
INTO THE ALL-OUT WAR IT DREADS AT THIS MOMENT. MOST LIKELY IT WOULD 
SPELL THE END OF SOVIET COMMUNISM. 

ce ERUPTIONS OF INTERNATIONAL TENSION BETRAY SOVIET WORRY THAT 
THE APPEARANCE OF WORLD PEACE SURELY WOULD REVIVE PRESSURE FROM THE 
SOVIET POPULATION FOR A FAIRER SHARE OF THE ECONOMY. THAT PROBABLY 
WOULD LEAD TO THE RISE OF A NEW AND FAR MORE RADICAL MALENKOV. 

IF IT WERE A MATTER OF EUROPE AND THE SOVIET UNION ALONE, SAY 
THE EXPERTS, THE CHANCES OF WAR WOULD BE LESS TODAY THAN AT ANY TIME IN 
THE FIVE YEARS SINCE THE NORTH ATLANTIC TREATY ORGANIZATION WAS BORN. 
BUT THERE REMAINS THE SPUTTERING FUSE IN ASIA. 

THE IDEA THAT ANY WAR IN ANY PART OF THE WORLD MIGHT TURN INTO A 
GENERAL CONFLICT Is REGARDED AS A POWERFUL REASON FOR MOSCOW TO LAY 
A RESTRAINING HAND UPON COMMUNIST CHINAs FORMOSA IS ALREADY VALUABLE 
TO THE COMMUNIST WORLD AS A READY SOURCE OF INTERNATIONAL TENSION WHEN 
TENSION IS REGARDED AS NECESSARY FOR THE ACCOMPLISHMENT OF IMMEDIATE 
RED PURPOSES. THE THREAT TO "LIBERATE*® FORMOSA BY FORCE IS ENOUGH TO 
CREATE THE TENSION. BUT AN ATTEMPT TO CARRY OUT THE THREAT COULD 
EXPLODE THE POSSIBILITY OF ULTIMATE DISASTER. 

ASIDE FROM THE THREAT IN ASIA, THE OTHER FACTORS WHICH COULD TOUCH 
OFF WORLD CONFLICT ARE DESPERATION, FEAR, MISCALCULATION OR ACCIDENT. 
NATO IS IN THE PROCESS OF BUILDING STRONG DETERRENTS TO THE FIRST THREE 


AND DEFENSES AGAINST THE FOURTH.

AT NATO HEADQUARTERS, THE PRIMARY CONCERN IS ARMING 12 GERMAN 
DIVISIONS AND INTEGRATING THEM. WITH NATO LAND FORCES. THERE MUST BE 
A GERMAN ARMY IN BEING, THE EXPERTS SAY, WITH ITS STRUCTURE ADAPTED TO 
THE CONTINGENCY OF NUCLEAR WARFARE. OTHERWISE GERMANY REPRESENTS 
A DANGEROUS VACUUM IN EUROPE. 

NATO STRATEGY IS TO DEFEND AS FAR TO THE EAST AS POSSIBLE. THERE

THE HAGUE, NETHERLANUS, APE R (AP) -WEST GERMAN REARMAMENT RE- 
EIVED ITS FINAL PARLIAMENTARY BLESS DAY. THE DUTCH SENATE 
CAST A HISTORIC 32-2 VOTE FOR THE PARIS TREATIES. IT WAS THE LAST 
SUCH ENDORSEMENT NEEDED TO BRING WEST GERMANY INTO THE WESTERN 
ALLIANCE AGAINST COMMUNISM. 

THE DUTCH LOWER HOUSE APPROVED THE PACTS 71-6 MARCH 30. $0 
NOW, AFTER NEARLY FIVE YEARS OF EMOTIONAL AND POLITICAL STRUGGLE, 
THE PARLIAMENTS OF ALL 15 NATIONS AFFECTED HAVE VOTED FOR WEST 
GERMANY'S SOVEREIGNTY AND THE RIGHT TO RECRUIT ARMED FORCES THAT WILL 
EVENTUALLY TOTAL A HALF MILLION SOLDIERS, SAILORS AND AIRMEN. 

CEREMONIES MARKING WEST GERMANY’S CHANGE FROM AN EX-ENEMY TO A 
FULL WESTERN POWER WILL TAKE PLACE EARLY NEXT MONTH--10 YEARS AFTER 
THE UNCONDITIONAL SURRENDER OF HITLER'S REICH. THE SIGNED TREATIES

THE THREE MAIN FACTORS AFFECTING THE SPEED OF REARMAMENT ARES. 

“THE GERMANS HAVE TO START FROM SCRATCH TO CREATE MODERN 
FORCES FOR THE ATOM AGE. THE MOST SERIOUS SHORTAGE IS THE LACK 
OF QUALIFIED YOUNG OFFICERS AND NONCOMS. 

2e A MASS OF LEGISLATION IS REQUIRED TO LEGALIZE THE RAISING OF 
ARMED FORCES. PARLIAMENT'S DETERMINATION TO HAVE STRICT CONTROL 
OVER ALL PHASES OF REARMAMENT WILL MAKE THIS A SLOW PROCESS. 

3. THE PUBLIC IS SO RELUCTANT TO REARM TO REARM THAT IT WILL BE 
POLITICALLY IMPOSSIBLE TO PUT TOO MUCH STEAM BEHIND THE DRIVE UNTIL 
ALL POSSIBILITY OF A SETTLEMENT WITH RUSSIA HAS CLEARLY DIS- 
APPEARED. THE OPPOSITION SOCIALISTS ARE HITTING HARD THE THEME 
THAT THERE WILL STILL BE A CHANCE OF GETTING MOSCOW'S AGREEMENT TO 


REUNIFICATION OF GERMANY SO LONG AS BONN'S ARMED FORCES, EXIST ONLY ON 


PAPER.

WILL BE DIVIDED INTO 350,000 SOLDIERS IN 12 DIVISIONS, 85,000 
AIRMEN IN A. 1,300-PLANE TACTICAL AIR FORCE AND 65,000 SAIL 
COASTA "

UNDER THE WEU ARRANGEMENT, WEST GERMANY WILL CREATE AN ARMY OF SIX 
MOTORIZED DIVISIONS, FOUR TANK DIVISIONS AND TWO MECHANIZED 
INFANTRY DIVISIONS, AN AIR FORCE OF JET FIGHTERS AND MEDIUM 
BOMBERS AND A NAVY OF COASTAL DEFENSE CRAFT. 

THIS FORCE WILL NUMBER 500,000 MEN. LIKE THE OTHER WEU FORCES 
STATIONED ON THE CONTINENT, THE GERMAN DEFENSE FORCE WILL BE SUBJECT 
TO GRUENTHER’S OVER-ALL COMMAND. 

THE WEU PLAN CONTAINS SAFEGUARDS AGAINST RUNAWAY WEST GERMAN 
REARMAMENT, ALTHOUGH FEWER THAN THE EDC PLAN. WEU HAS THE RIGHT 
TO SET CEILINGS ON THE ARMED FORCES OF ITS MEMBERS. THUS FRANCE 
"AN VETO ANY INCREASE IN WEST GERMANY'S MILITARY FORCES. 

A SEVEN-NATION ARMAMENTS AGENCY WILL CONTROL AND CHECK THE ARMA- 
MENTS LEVELS TO THE WEU MEMBERS. MUCH OF WEST GERMANY’S 
MILITARY SUPPLY SYSTEM ALSO WILL BE SUBJECT TO NATO CONTROL.

THAT AIR POWER. COUPLED WITH ATOMIC WEAPONS, FORMED THE DECISIVE ARM 
IN EVENT OF WAR. 
HE SAID WARNING OF ANY IMPENDING ATTACK BY "A FEW HOURS, OR 
EVEN A FEW MINUTES" WOULD SAVE THOUSANDS OF LIVES, BUT THAT PLANNERS 
MUST BE PREPARED FOR A COMPLETE SURPRISE ASSAULT. 
THE EXERCISE BROUGHT TOGETHER THE CHIEFS OF STAFF OF EVERY NATO 
POWER EXCEPT THE UNITED STATES. THE UNITED STATES SENT A SELECTION 
OF GENERALS, INCLUDING GEN. CURTIS LEMAY, CHIEF OF THE UsSe 


STRATEGIC AIR COMMAND, THE MAIN ATOMIC ARM OF THE WEST. 
SCIENTIFIC EXPERTS FROM THE 14 NATO NATIONS ALSO PARTICIPATED IN 


THE ANNUAL REVIEW, WHICH THIS YEAR STRESSED MORE THAN EVER THE EFFECT 
OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS ON WARFARE. 
MONTGOMERY SKIRTED SUBJECTS WHICH INTRUDED INTO SECRET MILITARY 

PLANNING, BUT LEFT THE IMPRESSION THAT THE NATO COMMAND STRUCTURE 
HAD BEEN GIVEN A THOROUGH BRIEFING ON ATOMIC PROBLEMS AND THAT THE 
RESULT WAS ENCOURAGING. 

HE SAID HE FELT A PRESSING NEED FOR BETTER "HOME DEFENSE," THAT 
PROMPT AND PROPER MEASURES WOULD RESULT IN SAVING THOUSANDS OF 
LIVES IN THE EVENT OF ATOMIC WAR. OTHERWISE, *THE CONFUSION AND 
DISORDER AND PANIC" THAT MIGHT FOLLOW AN ATOMIC ATTACK COULD BE OF 


GREATER CONSEQUENCE THAN THE ATTACK ITSELF.

COAL-STEEL COMMUNITY AWAY FROM FRANCE.

NOT GET IT BACK. THE FAMILY HAS REJECTED FRENCH OFFERS TO BUY THEM

THE TOOL IS A LOW POWER NUCLEAR REACTOR, OR ATOMIC FURNACE, UNIQUE 
IN THAT IT IS IMMERSED IN WATER TO PROTECT OPERATORS FROM RADIATIONe 

DEVELOPED BY OAK RIDGE SCIENTISTS, THE FACILITY IS USED CHIEFLY AS 
AN AID IN THE TESTING OF SHIELDS. SHIELDING HAS BEEN ONE OF THE MOST 
IMPORTANT PROBLEMS CONFRONTING SCIENTISTS SEEKING TO DEVELOP ATOMIC 


SOWER UNITS FOR AIRCRAFT AND OTHER PURPOSES. 
THE OCCASION FOR TAKING THE WRAPS OFF THIS “SWIMMING POOL" REACTOR 


IS THE OPENING HERE MONDAY OF A FOUR-WEEK TRAINING COURSE IN THE 








USE OF RADIOACTIVE ISOTOPES, OR TRACER ATOMS, FOR Se SCIENTISTS FROM 


cl FOREIGN COUNTRIES.» 
TRACER ATOMS ARE REGARDED AS ONE OF THE TOP TOOLS IN MODERN RE- 


SEARCHe THE COMMISSION HAS SPONSORED SINCE 1948 A TRAINING COURSE TO 
TEACH SCIENTISTS AND TECHNICIANS HOW TO USE THEM. THE COURSE IS CON- 
DUCTED BY THE OAK RIDGE INSTITUTE OF NUCLEAR STUDIES UNDER CONTRACT 


WITH AEC. | 
MORE THAN 1,300 PERSONS, INCLUDING 55 ALIENS,- HAVE TAKEN THE COURSE 
IN THE PAST SEVEN YEARS. HOWEVER, THIS IS THE FIRST CLASS WHICH HAS 
BEEN MADE UP EXCLUSIVELY OF FOREIGNERS.
